items.escena: A clay wall rack with four labelled clay bins, each holding a different chunky clay tool: a pencil, a ruler, a clock and a magnifying glass
A small clay balance scale with a clay note card on one pan tipping it decisively toward one of two clay tool blocks
A clay magnifying glass held over a small stack of clay books with a graduation cap resting on the top one
A clay spring of water rising from a rock into a basin, with a clay document resting at the source itself
Four identical clay file cards on a rail, each with the same three raised bars in the same positions, like a repeating pattern
Three clay document slabs stacked with slight offsets so all three edges show, each one a little thicker than the one below
One clay document on a desk and an identical clay document inside a closed clay safe beside it, a chunky arrow linking them
Five small clay step tiles laid in a row on a desk, linked in order by a thin clay ribbon of arrows
A clay page standing upright with ruled lines and a chunky clay cursor bar blinking at the end of one line
A clay grid of small square cells on a board, three cells holding chunky clay counters and one cell holding a clay plus sign
A clay projection screen on a stand showing one big clay shape, with three small clay slide cards lined up below it
Two identical clay hard-drive blocks side by side on a shelf, joined by a thick clay cable looping between them
A clay page being traced over another clay page on a light table, the top page missing the small clay tag that the bottom one carries
